inspection_summary: Inspected all 669 normalized lines. The article is mathematically coherent but its two-column text layer interleaves parallel arguments and several formulas have OCR layout risk. Material spans cover the computational-refutation framing, the generic-versus-explicit representation instrument, the Baez-Duarte equivalence and zero decomposition, the mechanism and extreme delay of an off-critical-line signal, and the numerical-error diagnosis that turns an apparent discrepancy into 996-digit agreement without providing evidence for RH.

sections_inspected.label: Front matter and abstract
sections_inspected.mathematical_role: Bibliographic metadata plus the source's claimed two-formula computer-refutation experiment and reported outcome.

sections_inspected.label: I. Introduction
sections_inspected.mathematical_role: Frames computer refutation, surveys related equivalent or stronger criteria and counterexamples, and motivates comparing a generic formula with a zeros-based explicit formula.

sections_inspected.label: II. The Baez-Duarte criterion for the Riemann Hypothesis
sections_inspected.mathematical_role: Derives the sequence criterion from Maslanka's zeta representation, decomposes the sequence into trivial-zero trend and nontrivial-zero oscillation, and rewrites the latter for asymptotic and numerical use.

sections_inspected.label: III. The scenario of violation of the Riemann Hypothesis
sections_inspected.mathematical_role: Explains how an off-critical-line zero changes a power of k, eventually breaks the RH decay envelope, and can remain numerically invisible until an astronomically large index.

sections_inspected.label: IV. The computer experiment
sections_inspected.mathematical_role: Implements both representations, budgets zero-tail precision, diagnoses derivative errors, and uses convergence and plateau behavior to certify the achieved agreement.

sections_inspected.label: V. Final remarks
sections_inspected.mathematical_role: States the negative evidential conclusion and identifies strong sensitivity to high zeros as the missing property of a viable computer-refutation quantity.

accepted_units.title: Computer refutation through finitely detectable failure
accepted_units.why_material: Distinguishes computer proof from the plausibility of numerical refutation, then uses Polya, Mertens, Lagarias, and Robin-type examples to show how one counterexample or a near-violated equivalent condition can organize a search for failure.
accepted_units.context_note: Immutable v1 span retained exactly. The normalized two-column extraction continues some criteria and the proposed dual-formula instrument beyond line 119; use the recorded context repair rather than rewriting this unit.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Medium: prose is recoverable, but paired columns interleave definitions and formulas, so criterion formulas should be checked with their repaired context.

accepted_units.title: Near-boundary criteria motivate a dual-representation falsification test
accepted_units.why_material: Relates near-boundary equivalent criteria to the broader pattern that elementary quantities also admit zero-explicit representations, then states the experiment's key asymmetry: compute once without zero data and once through a finite high-precision zero sum, with a certified disagreement serving as a possible refutation signal.
accepted_units.context_note: The span includes de Bruijn-Newman and Li material in one column and the proposed experiment plus Chebyshev/Mertens explicit-formula examples in the other; the wider range is required because the normalized reading order interleaves the columns.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: High: several displayed formulas are column-interleaved and OCR-fragmented, although the conceptual comparison and slow-convergence warning are explicit in prose.

accepted_units.title: Maslanka continuation coefficients induce the Baez-Duarte decay criterion
accepted_units.why_material: Connects a globally convergent representation of zeta to the finite-difference coefficients c_k and states the equivalence between RH and c_k=O(k^{-3/4+epsilon}), supplying the semantic bridge from a representation change to an asymptotic criterion.
accepted_units.context_note: Read the coefficient formulas as checked text-layer mathematics; line 235 is the frozen criterion statement and the following carried unit supplies its zero decomposition.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: High: gamma, Bernoulli, and binomial notation is recoverable but visually fragmented by OCR and two-column ordering.

accepted_units.title: Trivial-zero trend versus nontrivial-zero oscillation
accepted_units.why_material: Separates c_k into a rapidly decreasing trend from trivial zeros and an oscillatory contribution from nontrivial zeros, showing that the k^{-3/4} behavior relevant to RH is carried by the oscillatory part rather than the k^{-2} trend.
accepted_units.context_note: Immutable v1 span retained exactly. It begins after the explicit split is introduced in the interleaved right column and ends before the full residue and gamma-function representation; use the recorded repair for safe interpretation.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: High: the central decomposition and asymptotic roles are clear in prose, but exact constants and gamma factors depend on formula layout.

accepted_units.title: Residues and Pochhammer asymptotics turn zero data into a fast oscillatory formula
accepted_units.why_material: Rewrites the nontrivial-zero contribution from residues through Pochhammer and gamma functions, pairs conjugate zeros, uses the Pochhammer asymptotic, and under RH exposes exponential gamma decay and first-zero dominance; it also defines the generic and explicit computational routes compared later.
accepted_units.context_note: The two columns carry parallel derivation stages, so the full span is needed to connect formulas (20)-(30) and the definitions of c_k^g and c_k^e.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: High: exact residue, gamma, real-part, and summation notation should be scan-verified before formula-level reuse; the transformation logic is recoverable from prose.

accepted_units.title: RH failure becomes escape of the rescaled sequence from a fixed strip
accepted_units.why_material: Turns the asymptotic criterion into a geometric diagnostic: if RH holds, k^{3/4}c_k remains bounded, while a violating contribution must eventually force escape; it also fixes the simple-zero setting used for the subsequent mechanism analysis.
accepted_units.context_note: This is the setup immediately preceding the carried delayed-effect analysis and is included in that unit's repair range.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Medium: exponents and the constant are formula-dependent, but the bounded-strip interpretation is explicit in prose.

accepted_units.title: An off-critical-line zero changes a k exponent but may surface only astronomically late
accepted_units.why_material: Shows that zeta-derivative size changes constants rather than the decisive exponent, while a zero with real displacement delta contributes k^{-3/4+delta/2}; exponential suppression in its height makes the crossover index enormous and makes a truncated explicit zero sum unable to expose it at feasible k.
accepted_units.context_note: Immutable v1 span retained exactly. The span omits the bounded-strip setup and ends before the argument completes the missing-zero detection logic; use the recorded context repair.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: High: the power-law and gamma-decay mechanism is prose-supported, but OCR damages several superscripts and the heuristic crossover formula.

accepted_units.title: Catastrophic cancellation makes the generic finite sum a precision-certification problem
accepted_units.why_material: The generic c_100000 computation sums enormous intermediate terms to a tiny result; rerunning at substantially higher working precision and comparing outputs provides a bounded accuracy claim, while the explicit route must retain exact k+1 terms at thousand-digit scale.
accepted_units.context_note: The start overlaps the carried violation unit because the normalized page transition finishes its truncation argument while beginning Section IV.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Medium: exact magnitude and timing claims are readable; the table layout is damaged but is not needed for the cancellation mechanism.

accepted_units.title: Gamma-tail decay converts a decimal target into a required zero cutoff
accepted_units.why_material: Uses exponential decay of the zero terms to estimate how many zeros are needed for 1000-digit accuracy, separately checks that the zeros themselves satisfy zeta to roughly the target precision, and records an 87-digit mismatch that must still be treated as a numerical failure candidate rather than an RH refutation.
accepted_units.context_note: This unit deliberately ends at the first mismatch; the next unit follows the derivative computation that repairs it.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: High: numerical cutoff reasoning depends on the gamma exponent and indexed-zero formulas, which are recoverable but OCR-sensitive.

accepted_units.title: Derivative accuracy, not zero accuracy, controls the apparent discrepancy
accepted_units.why_material: Derives a termwise-differentiated alternating-series representation for zeta prime, applies convergence acceleration beyond its stated complex-series scope, and shows successive derivative recomputations shifting the generic-explicit disagreement from 87 to 625 digits before a higher internal precision run.
accepted_units.context_note: Overlap with the tail-budget unit retains the causal chain from required explicit-sum accuracy through derivative evaluation; the text itself flags the extrapolation beyond the acceleration routine's formal applicability.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: High: exact differentiated-series coefficients and inequality orientations are formula-layout dependent; the methodological caveat and precision progression are explicit.

accepted_units.title: Agreement and zero-sum plateaus diagnose the first bad derivative
accepted_units.why_material: The 996-digit agreement supplies posterior evidence that the recomputed derivatives are accurate for this calculation, while the y(n) diagnostic predicts improvement at the first-discarded-term rate and interprets a plateau as the earliest inaccurate derivative overwhelming all later exponentially suppressed terms.
accepted_units.context_note: Figure prose contains the evidential mechanism even though plotted curves are unavailable in the normalized text; exact y(n) notation is OCR-fragmented.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: High: interpretation is recoverable from prose, but formula (40), the plotted data, and gamma exponent require scan or figure verification for exact reuse.

accepted_units.title: High-precision agreement is not RH evidence; a refutation observable needs high-zero sensitivity
accepted_units.why_material: Explicitly rejects treating 996-digit agreement as evidence for RH and extracts a design requirement: a viable quantity needs both a zero-free representation and a zero-explicit representation with strong sensitivity to high zeros; the high-precision-fraud example warns that vast numerical agreement need not imply identity.
accepted_units.context_note: This is the source's final epistemic qualification; the following physical-charge analogy is not needed for the mathematical mechanism.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Medium: the conclusion is prose-grounded; the illustrative strange-series formula is OCR-damaged but its stated caution is clear.

within_source_synthesis_candidates.title: Two-representation falsification with asymmetric completeness
within_source_synthesis_candidates.claim: A quantity computed by a finite generic formula that implicitly contains all zero contributions can be compared with a zero-explicit formula truncated at certified height; after numerical error is excluded, a discrepancy could reveal a contribution missing from the explicit truncation.
within_source_synthesis_candidates.limit: The source does not establish that a feasible index is sensitive to such a zero, and an observed mismatch is uninterpretable until both routes, especially zeta derivatives, are independently certified.

within_source_synthesis_candidates.title: From RH decay to delayed off-line escape
within_source_synthesis_candidates.claim: The trend/oscillation split localizes the RH-sensitive behavior in the nontrivial-zero term; a real-part displacement changes its k exponent so the rescaled sequence must eventually escape a fixed envelope, while gamma decay in zero height delays that escape drastically.
within_source_synthesis_candidates.limit: The crossover estimates are heuristic, assume simple zeros and a separable off-line contribution, and imply no practical search bound.

within_source_synthesis_candidates.title: Exponential tails as resource estimates and error diagnostics
within_source_synthesis_candidates.claim: The same exponential decay that converts a desired decimal accuracy into a zero cutoff also predicts the improvement of partial explicit sums; departure from that prediction and a plateau localize the first inaccurate derivative value.
within_source_synthesis_candidates.limit: The first-discarded-term analogy is not presented as a rigorous bound, and exact use depends on formula and figure verification.

within_source_synthesis_candidates.title: Precision escalation separates numerical failure from mathematical signal
within_source_synthesis_candidates.claim: Independent higher-precision recomputation, targeted repair of the derivative bottleneck, and predictable convergence of zero partial sums transform early apparent discrepancies into a numerical error diagnosis rather than a conjecture-level conclusion.
within_source_synthesis_candidates.limit: Posterior agreement validates this finite computation only; it neither verifies RH nor rules out later discrepancies.

within_source_saturation: Saturated for source-grounded semantic depth: every mathematical section and all usable lines were inspected, and the accepted units cover each distinct reusable mechanism, representation change, obstruction, certification step, and epistemic limitation. Further splitting would chiefly isolate formulas from their required two-column context, duplicate selected mechanisms, or promote routine numerical/table detail and OCR-fragile notation without additional semantic yield.
stop_reason: The review stopped only after the complete 669-line partition was accounted for. All remaining unselected text is abstract repetition, page furniture, acknowledgments/references/biography, a repetitive physical analogy, or formula/table detail already represented by the selected mechanisms; no meaningful source material remains solely because of a unit quota.
